meta.name: Helluva Boss
meta.description: An adult animated comedy series created by Vivienne Medrano. It follows the Immediate Murder Professionals (I.M.P.), a small crew of imps who run an assassination business in Hell.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: The original pilot introduces I.M.P. and a job that splits the team. The creator has said it is not part of the main story.

videos.title: Mission: Zero
videos.overview: A reimagining of the pilot, in which Blitzo expands the business to target living humans and borrows Stolas's grimoire to get to Earth.

videos.title: Murder Family
videos.overview: A schoolteacher who died in a violent betrayal hires I.M.P. to finish off her husband's mistress. The job leads the crew into the home of a family of devil-worshipping cannibals.

videos.title: Loo Loo Land
videos.overview: Stolas hires I.M.P. to guard him and his daughter Octavia on a tense family day at an amusement park, where Blitzo also runs into an old, hostile coworker.

videos.title: Spring Broken
videos.overview: A fight over the company parking space with Blitzo's ex, the pop star Verosika Mayday, turns into a contest on Earth that goes wrong when a mutated fish attacks.

videos.title: C.H.E.R.U.B
videos.overview: An inventor newly arrived in Hell wants his old business partner dead, but a trio of cherubs from Heaven turns up to convince the target his life is worth living.

videos.title: The Harvest Moon Festival
videos.overview: I.M.P. visits Millie's family in the Wrath ring during a harvest festival, where a charming farmhand turns out to be an assassin targeting Stolas.

videos.title: Truth Seekers
videos.overview: Blitzo and Moxxie are captured by a secret agency on Earth and dosed with truth serum while the rest of the crew mounts a rescue.

videos.title: Ozzie's
videos.overview: Moxxie and Millie celebrate their anniversary at an exclusive restaurant in the Lust ring, and Blitzo schemes his way in by asking Stolas on a date.

videos.title: Queen Bee
videos.overview: Loona is invited to a hellhound party in the Gluttony ring, while Blitzo is still dealing with what happened at Ozzie's.

videos.title: The Circus
videos.overview: Flashbacks show how Stolas and Blitzo first met, then the story returns to the aftermath of their disastrous date.

videos.title: Seeing Stars
videos.overview: When Stolas forgets a promise to watch a meteor shower, Octavia runs off to Los Angeles with his grimoire and I.M.P. goes after her.

videos.title: Exes and Oohs
videos.overview: I.M.P. visits Moxxie's mafia-boss father, who tries to arrange Moxxie's marriage to a shark demon with a shady agenda.

videos.title: Western Energy
videos.overview: Striker kidnaps Stolas on Stella's orders, and I.M.P. steps in before a change of plan spares his life.

videos.title: Unhappy Campers
videos.overview: Moxxie leads a mission for the first time and it goes badly, while Blitzo tries to make peace with his estranged sister.

videos.title: Oops
videos.overview: Blitzo and Fizzarolli are held for ransom and have to cooperate to escape, mending an old friendship along the way.

videos.title: Mammon's Magnificent Musical Mid-Season Special (ft Fizzarolli)
videos.overview: Fizzarolli enters a clown pageant run by Mammon, with Blitzo hired as his bodyguard, and a secret relationship comes into the open.

videos.title: The Full Moon
videos.overview: Blitzo gets ready for his monthly night with Stolas while rival groups from Heaven and the human world hunt him.

videos.title: Apology Tour
videos.overview: After another fight with Stolas, Blitzo tries apologising to people he has wronged, ending at a party that forces him to face his behaviour.

videos.title: Ghostf**ckers
videos.overview: Reeling from his breakup, Blitzo drags I.M.P. to a haunted hotel for a job and ends up tormented by his own guilt.

videos.title: Mastermind
videos.overview: I.M.P. is arrested and put on trial in Hell, and Stolas makes a costly choice to save Blitzo.

videos.title: Sinsmas
videos.overview: I.M.P. celebrates Hell's version of Christmas while Stolas tries to reconnect with Octavia, and the team's holiday job doesn't go as planned.

videos.title: Turtle Emoji
videos.overview: Stolas sends Blitzo a turtle emoji, setting off unexpected developments in their relationship.

videos.title: Bad Reputation
videos.overview: Millie takes centre stage as questions about her reputation and her future come up.

videos.title: Gimpy Gimpy
videos.overview: The crew travels to Australia for another unpredictable adventure.
